`[ALG]` [RID: RECOG-ALG-A1C-RECIPROCAL-DRIFT] [scope: $x_0\in U$, chart row A, block base points; adopted rows only — DYAD-ALG-NF6 ($\mu$, $a_{32}$, $a_{05}$), DYAD-THM-NF-REM ($C_7=100$, one-orbit contraction), the part-1b closed forms and $c_\theta$; no Dyadic proof constant] [proof: cell `records/recog/RECOG_A1C_DRIFT_CENTERING_SESSION_v0_1.md` v0.3 §§1–3 (Lemmas 21–22, Prop. 23) and §2a (the proof table of Lemma 22); certificate RECOG-ART-A1C-DRIFT-CENTERING] (i) *Exact first order.* $\delta_m:=q_{m+1}^{-1}-q_m^{-1}-1=-\tfrac{29}{216}q_m-2\operatorname{Re}(a_{05}e^{-6i\Theta_m})q_m+R_m$, $|R_m|\le\gamma_2q_m^2$, $\gamma_2=212.6$ (of which $2C_7=200$ is the NF-REM tail ceiling $|2\operatorname{Re}(\rho_7/z)|/q\le2C_7q^2$): the isotropic coefficient is the exact $1-|\mu|^2-2\operatorname{Re}a_{32}=-\tfrac{29}{216}$ and the sixth harmonic has zero mean.
